name: Coinbase AgentKit
description: Framework-agnostic toolkit giving agents on-chain wallet actions.
descriptionZh: 框架无关的工具包，为 Agent 提供链上钱包操作能力。
keyFact: Coinbase AgentKit launched in November 2024 and is wallet- and framework-agnostic (CDP, Viem, Privy, ZeroDev), exposing 50+ on-chain actions in TypeScript and 30+ in Python; it integrates with LangChain, the Vercel AI SDK and MCP, and requires a CDP API key.
keyFactZh: Coinbase AgentKit 于 2024 年 11 月上线，与钱包和框架解耦（支持 CDP、Viem、Privy、ZeroDev），在 TypeScript 中提供 50+ 链上动作、Python 中提供 30+；它集成 LangChain、Vercel AI SDK 与 MCP，需要 CDP API Key。
caveat: GitHub's license detector reports NOASSERTION even though the package metadata states Apache-2.0; verify before redistribution.
caveatZh: 尽管包元数据标注 Apache-2.0，GitHub 的许可证检测结果为 NOASSERTION；再分发前请自行核实。
